passive.name: Hemorrhage
passive.desc: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage when his target reaches max stacks.

spells.name: Decimate
spells.desc: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.

spells.name: Crippling Strike
spells.desc: Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.

spells.name: Apprehend
spells.desc: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor. When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

spells.name: Noxian Guillotine
spells.desc: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.
